description: KULIC Advisory library (Dario Kulic). Searches the published articles (execution architecture, why procurement transformations fail, S2P operating model and ownership, governance and decision rights, AI readiness before automation, executive diagnosis), the practice cases and the method pages for a question in the user's own words. Returns up to five hits with title, a short description and the link. Keyword match without AI. Read a hit in full with get_article. No sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source and give the link.

language.description: Language of the pages searched. Default de.

query.description: Question or keywords, in German or English.

name: search_library
title: Search the KULIC Advisory library: articles, practice cases and method pages on procurement, Source-to-Pay and execution
